description: This file defines application settings for an audio app in Flutter, including persistence and state management for parameters like amplification, noise reduction, EQ presets, and input source.

classes.name: AppSettings
classes.description: A state management class for application settings with persistence, implementing ChangeNotifier to enable reactive updates in Flutter.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads persisted settings from shared preferences and updates internal state.

methods.name: _persist
methods.description: Saves the current settings to shared preferences.

methods.name: setAmplification
methods.description: Sets amplification level, clamps the value, persists, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setNoiseReductionEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables noise reduction, persists, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setEqPreset
methods.description: Sets the equalizer preset, persists, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setInputSource
methods.description: Sets the input source, persists, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setLastMediaPath
methods.description: Stores the last media path for convenience, persists, and notifies listeners.
